description: Source code for DeviceClient Request Handler in a TR-069 host interface, managing device info, process, and firmware parameters, including get/set operations, notifications, and update checks.

classes.name: DeviceClientReqHandler
classes.description: Handles device info, process, and firmware parameters, including get/set operations, notifications, and update checks.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets current process and processor counts to zero.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes process and processor counts to zero.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Closes all device info, processor, and process status instances.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles setting device parameters such as reset, firmware download, and device info.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Retrieves device info, process, processor, and process status data.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Gets notification attribute status for parameters.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Sets notification attribute status for parameters.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks and triggers add/remove and value change events for device info and process parameters.

methods.name: notifyIARM
methods.description: Broadcasts an event via IARM bus for parameter changes.
